document_strings: I born Supreme Epstein on December 4, 1916 was the first beautiful baby born to Julius & Bess.
Bess was the of a beautiful woman...
My father was born in Russia.
My mother was born in Brest LaTose in Poland.
My father started his business in the year of 1900.
He was in business for 44 years before he passed away.
Then we moved to Crown St...
Before... enlisted in the U.S. Army.
